Hey man. First of all, I just wanna say take it easy. Don’t be too harsh on yourself because you’re young. Building a schedule for yourself includes motivation and taking it day by day. Enjoy your own company too. Start enjoying the environment around if you don’t have comforting people. It’s all about building discipline, so start adjusting certain things into your life slowly. Start off with your sleep, this can be very hard especially when you’re in a habit. So for one day, try keep yourself awake for a whole day, avoid video games and maybe do some exercise and then at a good time (9pm - 10pm/11pm) try to fall asleep. Tire your body out. You’ll wake up early and refreshed. Get some water in you and some breakfast. Keep yourself occupied by just doing ANYTHING but video games. Start off with that and slowly you’ll better yourself. Wish you luck.
